import os,re
root='/bench/repo'
files=[]
for d,ds,fs in os.walk(root):
 if '/.git' in d: continue
 for f in fs:
  if f.endswith('.go'): files.append(os.path.join(d,f))
# declarations in internal
pat=re.compile(r'^\s*func\s+(?:\(([^)]*)\)\s*)?([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\(',re.M)
decls=[]
for p in files:
 if '/internal/' not in p and not p.endswith('/internal'): continue
 s=open(p,errors='ignore').read()
 for m in pat.finditer(s):
  recv=m.group(1); name=m.group(2)
  line=s.count('\n',0,m.start())+1
  decls.append((name,p,line,recv or ''))
# occurrence count, rough calls (identifier followed by (, excludes declaration line)
alltext='\n'.join(open(p,errors='ignore').read() for p in files)
for name,p,line,recv in sorted(decls):
 occ=[]
 rg=re.compile(r'(?<![\w.])'+re.escape(name)+r'\s*\(')
 for q in files:
  s=open(q,errors='ignore').read()
  for m in rg.finditer(s):
   ln=s.count('\n',0,m.start())+1
   # skip declaration matching same line; receiver methods may declaration
   if q==p and ln==line: continue
   occ.append((q,ln))
 print(f'{len(occ):3} {name} {p}:{line} recv={recv} callers={len(set(x[0] for x in occ))}')
PY
